log.action: Use Shield Wall and brace against the slavers.

The slavers crash into your guard, but your braced stance turns their rush into a shower of sparks. Theron’s blade skids from your mail, while a hooked knife slips through and bites shallow flesh.🔊………

log.action: Take cover behind the burning merchant wagon.
log.narration: Turn 2 | Day 1, 7:02 pmDexterity checkd20: 17 -- successTheron Wyndfall attackd20: 11 -- failedSlaver pack attackd20: 13 -- successYou dive behind the wagon as its axle splits with a shriek of iron. Flame claws across your shieldless flank, but you roll through the heat and come up behind the shattered wheel, smoke masking your position.🔊………

log.action: Use Shield Wall and brace against the slavers.
log.narration: Turn 3 | Day 1, 7:03 pmSlaver pack attackd20: 14 -- successTheron Wyndfall attackd20: 15 -- successYou wrench the broken wheel into a shield and crouch behind its smoking rim. The slavers hammer at your guard, but their hooks find only charred timber and iron. Theron’s sword thrusts through the smoke and grazes your ribs before your stance crushes the force of the blow.🔊………

log.action: Strike Theron through the smoke.
log.narration: Turn 4 | Day 1, 7:04 pmLongsword attack, Theron Wyndfalld20: 18 -- successLongsword damaged20: 10 -- successYou drive the longsword through the smoke. Steel tears Theron’s shoulder and hurls him against the wagon’s blazing side, but the scarred slaver keeps his feet, blood black upon his mail.🔊………

log.action: Retreat toward the North Road.
log.narration: Turn 5 | Day 1, 7:05 pmDexterity checkd20: 16 -- successSlaver pack attackd20: 7 -- failedYou break from the burning wagon and sprint north through ash, with hooked blades snapping at your heels. One slaver lunges, but you twist aside and leave only a strip of mail in his fist. Theron’s roar follows you through the smoke, promising that the pits have not forgotten your name.🔊………

log.action: Finish Theron with a killing thrust.
log.narration: Turn 6 | Day 1, 7:06 pmLongsword killing thrust, Theron Wyndfalld20: 19 -- successThe wounded slaver staggers from the smoke, and you turn upon him before he can raise his blade. Your longsword enters beneath his ribs and bursts from his back, pinning Theron Wyndfall against the wagon’s scorched timber. His blood darkens the ash, and the dying man spits one final word, “Cage.”🔊………

log.action: Use Shield Wall behind the broken wheel.
log.narration: Turn 7 | Day 1, 7:07 pmYou wedge your shoulder behind the shattered wheel and set your feet in the iron-scattered road. The stance hardens your body into a bastion, though no living foe yet dares close with you. Beneath Theron’s corpse, a brass token glints through the soot, stamped with a cage whose bars curve inward like claws.🔊………

log.action: Inspect the burning wagon for surviving supplies.
log.narration: Turn 8 | Day 1, 7:37 pmPerception checkd20: 15 -- successYou crawl into the wagon’s smoking belly and rake aside blackened grain sacks. Heat bites through your gloves, but beneath the wreckage you find a sealed black-glass ampoule marked with the inward-curving cage, and a hidden iron token bears the same sign. The token’s edge is warm as fresh blood, while distant bells begin to toll from the southern road.🔊………

log.action: Search Theron Wyndfall’s body for clues.
log.narration: Turn 9 | Day 1, 8:07 pmPerception checkd20: 16 -- successYou search Theron’s corpse beneath the wagon’s falling sparks. A strip of skin sewn inside his collar bears a black mark, three hooked bars around a hollow center, and beneath it the words, “The King is bound.” His purse holds no coin, but a smear of violet elixir stains his fingers, carrying the bitter reek of grave-soil.🔊………

log.action: Run north before the southern bells draw pursuers.
log.narration: Turn 10 | Day 1, 10:07 pmYou leave the wreck behind and drive north beneath the ash-choked sky. The road climbs through thorn scrub toward a ridge of black stone, and something heavy crashes through the brush behind you without showing its face. At the crest, fresh bootprints cut across the dust, three pursuers moving fast.🔊………

log.action: Take the east wagon trail toward the Blighted Reach.
log.narration: Turn 11 | Day 1, 10:27 pmYou leave the hard road and enter the ravine trail, where thorn branches claw at your mail. The passage narrows beneath black cliffs, and ash drifts upward from cracks in the earth. A gaunt hound erupts from the gray dust with a furnace glowing in its rib cage, cutting off the trail ahead.🔊………

log.action: Take the east wagon trail toward the Blighted Reach.
log.narration: Turn 12 | Day 1, 10:28 pmAshen Hound attackd20: 16 -- hitThe eastern trail remains barred by the beast. You step toward it, and the ash hound springs low, jaws opening around a furnace glow. Its teeth rake your mail and slam you against the ravine wall.🔊………

log.action: Examine the collar strip and cage mark closely.
log.narration: Turn 13 | Day 1, 10:29 pmPerception checkd20: 17 -- successYou wrench the cage-marked token from your belt and hold it beside the strip’s burned symbol. The hooked bars match, but the center is not ink, it is a tiny puncture burned through the leather. The hound lunges while your eyes measure the mark, and its claws tear across your ribs.🔊………

log.action: Retreat west along the trail toward North Road.
log.narration: Turn 14 | Day 1, 10:59 pmStrength checkd20: 16 -- successYou turn west and run beneath the screaming cliffs. The ash hound snaps at your back, but the trail collapses under its forelegs and buries it in choking dust. You stagger onto the hard stones of North Road as the ravine fades behind you.🔊………

log.action: Retreat west along the trail toward North Road.
log.narration: Turn 15 | Day 1, 11:09 pmYou limp west until the ravine gives way to the hard-packed North Road. Ash sweeps across the stones, hiding the hound’s trail, but a horn sounds far behind you in the wilderness. Then a second horn answers from the southern descent, trapping the road between two hunting calls.🔊………

log.action: Raise my shield and brace against its next attack.
log.narration: Turn 16 | Day 1, 11:10 pmYou find no shield at your side, only the broken wheel and your sword. You plant your boots and brace behind the wreckage, turning its charred spokes toward the horn calls. No attacker reaches you before the wind dies, but something answers from the southern road with a wet, animal growl.🔊………

log.action: Raise my shield and brace against its next attack.
log.narration: Turn 17 | Day 1, 11:11 pmDarvak Vareth spear attackd20: 15 -- hitYou brace behind the broken wheel as a scarred dwarf bursts from the southern scrub, spear leveled at your heart. The shaft strikes your guard and skids aside, but the impact numbs your arm.🔊………

log.action: Retreat west along the trail toward North Road.
log.narration: Turn 18 | Day 1, 11:12 pmDexterity checkd20: 11 -- failedDarvak Vareth spear attackd20: 17 -- hitYou break from the wheel and sprint along the road, seeking distance from Darvak’s spear. The dwarf reads your movement and cuts across the stones, driving the weapon into your thigh before you can clear him. Your braced stance turns the thrust aside enough to spare the bone, but blood darkens your mail.🔊………

log.action: Sprint north along North Road.
log.narration: Turn 19 | Day 1, 11:13 pmDexterity checkd20: 9 -- failedYou drive north with blood soaking your boot, but your wounded leg buckles on the first rise. Darvak Vareth strides past you and plants his spear across the road, sealing the way. The dwarf’s beard bristles with ash as he lowers the point toward your throat.🔊………

log.action: Use Shield Wall behind the broken wheel.
log.narration: Turn 20 | Day 1, 11:14 pmDarvak Vareth spear attackd20: 15 -- hitYou throw yourself behind the broken wheel and lock your stance as Darvak Vareth thrusts over the splintered rim. The spearhead bites wood instead of flesh, and the wreckage shudders beneath the blow.🔊………

log.action: Attempt to sprint past Darvak Vareth.
log.narration: Turn 21 | Day 1, 11:15 pmSprinting checkd20: 16 -- successYou explode from cover before Darvak Vareth can recover his spear. Your wounded leg screams, yet fury lends it iron, and you slip beyond the dwarf’s reach as his gauntlet claws empty air. The blockade breaks behind you, and the road carries you into the ash-blown north.🔊………

log.action: Dive behind the broken wheel.
log.narration: Turn 22 | Day 1, 11:16 pmYou dive behind the broken wheel as Darvak Vareth vanishes into the ash behind you. The wreckage remains beside the road, scarred by spear thrusts and darkened by your blood. Far ahead, a single lantern burns upon the northern ridge, though no road leads toward it.🔊………

log.action: Search the road for cover or danger.
log.narration: Turn 23 | Day 1, 11:46 pmPerception checkd20: 17 -- successYou rake the ash aside with your sword point and find fresh bootprints circling the wreckage. They belong to several adults, and one trail ends at a narrow shaft hidden beneath thorn roots. From below comes the wet click of something moving in the dark.🔊………

log.action: Look back for Darvak Vareth’s pursuit.
log.narration: Turn 24 | Day 1, 11:51 pmYou glance back along the road. Darvak Vareth is gone, but his spear has gouged a straight furrow through the ash toward the south. Beyond it, thorn branches bend one after another, tracking something that moves without showing itself. The hidden shaft gives a muffled scrape behind you, and the road ahead offers no silence at all.🔊………

log.action: Keep sprinting north along North Road.
log.narration: Turn 25 | Day 1, 12:01 amSprinting checkd20: 15 -- successYou sprint north until the road climbs beneath black stone and the ash thins to a bitter gray veil. Your wounded leg holds, but the thorn scrub ahead thrashes against the windless dark. Behind you, Darvak Vareth’s horn answers from the southern slope, closer than before, while something below the hidden shaft begins hammering against its buried cover.🔊………

log.action: Inspect the hidden shaft from a safe distance.
log.narration: Turn 26 | Day 1, 12:06 amPerception checkd20: 14 -- successYou stop beyond the shaft’s reach and study the thorn-choked hollow. The buried cover bucks once, then splits along a seam, revealing a ring of iron teeth beneath the roots. A pale hand curls through the gap, its fingers jointed like hooked branches, while Darvak Vareth’s horn sounds again far down the road.🔊………

log.action: Inspect the hidden shaft from a safe distance.
log.narration: Turn 27 | Day 1, 12:11 amPerception checkd20: 18 -- successYou crouch beyond the reach of the iron ring and study the ground around it. The ash bears no tracks from the thing below, only thin grooves where its unseen limbs have tested the soil. A low voice rises through the roots, speaking a word that makes the cage-marked token grow cold in your fist.🔊………

log.action: Hack at the pale hand with my sword.
log.narration: Turn 28 | Day 1, 12:12 amLongsword attackd20: 17 -- successThornroot Grasper claw attackd20: 8 -- failedYou lunge and hack at the pale hand. Steel severs two crooked fingers, and black sap spatters the roots as the creature hauls itself from the shaft. Its many-jointed arm lashes at your chest, but you twist aside and the claws rake only your chainmail.🔊………

log.action: Sprint north along the road.
log.narration: Turn 29 | Day 1, 12:13 amSprinting checkd20: 16 -- successYou wrench free of the shaft and sprint north, while Thornroot Grasper’s limbs rake sparks from the stones behind you. The creature shrieks beneath the ash, then recoils as the road rises beyond its reach. The hidden shaft remains open, breathing a stink of wet earth and old blood, and Darvak Vareth’s horn dies somewhere behind the ridge.🔊………

log.action: Retreat from the shaft behind the broken wheel.
log.narration: Turn 30 | Day 1, 12:14 amYou retreat to the broken wheel and crouch behind its blackened spokes. The shaft’s cover lies split behind you, and the pale limbs withdraw beneath the roots with a sound like wet timber tearing. For one breath the road is empty, then a violet glimmer stirs in the depths below.🔊………

log.action: Search the open shaft for clues while keeping distance.
log.narration: Turn 31 | Day 1, 12:44 amPerception checkd20: 19 -- successFrom behind the wheel, you probe the shaft with a broken spoke and watch the violet glow recoil. Beneath the torn cover, iron rungs descend into a chamber lined with black glass, and fresh scrape marks climb toward the road. A coppery stink rises from below, carrying the faint rhythm of breathing.🔊………

log.action: Smash the violet glimmer with my sword.
log.narration: Turn 32 | Day 1, 12:45 amLongsword attackd20: 7 -- failedYour sword cannot reach the violet glimmer from behind the wheel. You thrust anyway, and the blade stops against the shaft’s iron rim as the light suddenly swells beneath it. Something below answers with a deep, hungry breath, and the rungs begin to glow one by one. The chamber has yielded its secret, but not its safety.🔊………

log.action: Circle the broken wheel and watch for Thornroot Grasper.
log.narration: Turn 33 | Day 1, 12:50 amPerception checkd20: 15 -- successYou circle the wreck with your sword low, testing each patch of ash before your boot commits. The roots on the shaft’s far side twitch, then go still, but your trained eye catches a hooked limb withdrawing beneath the stones. Thornroot Grasper is not gone. It is waiting for your guard to fail.🔊………

log.action: Approach the shaft and hold the cage-marked token over it.
log.narration: Turn 34 | Day 1, 12:51 amThornroot Grasper claw attackd20: 16 -- hitYou approach the shaft and raise the cage-marked token above the black mouth. The iron rungs flare with violet fire, and Thornroot Grasper erupts from the roots in a storm of hooked limbs. Its claws snap toward your wrist, seeking the token rather than your flesh.🔊………

log.action: Sprint north beyond Thornroot Grasper’s reach.
log.narration: Turn 35 | Day 1, 12:52 amSprinting checkd20: 8 -- failedNo claw follows. Thornroot Grasper’s ruined remains lie tangled beneath the roots, and the shaft exhales violet light into the ash. Your wounded leg buckles before you can gain a true sprint, forcing you to stagger clear of the broken wheel instead.🔊………

log.action: Sprint north beyond Thornroot Grasper’s reach.
log.narration: Turn 36 | Day 1, 12:54 amSprinting checkd20: 14 -- successYou force your battered leg beneath you and drive north along the ash-choked road. The dead Thornroot Grasper remains behind, its black sap shining around the broken shaft. At last the roots fade from sight, but your strength deserts you beside a black stone marker, and you drop hard upon the road.🔊………

log.action: Sprint north beyond Thornroot Grasper’s reach.
log.narration: Turn 37 | Day 1, 12:55 amSprinting checkd20: 5 -- failedYour leg gives way before the road can carry you farther. You strike the ash hard, and the world narrows to cold stone beneath your cheek. Darvak Vareth emerges through the scrub with spear in hand, his pursuit finally spent, but his hatred remains sharp.🔊………

log.action: Probe the glowing iron rungs with the broken spoke.
log.narration: Turn 38 | Day 1, 12:56 amInvestigation checkd20: 9 -- failedYou drag the broken spoke toward the nearest glowing rung. The iron answers before the wood touches it, and violet fire leaps across the gap into your hand. Your fingers lock around the spoke while a whisper rises from the shaft, speaking no language known to you.🔊………

log.action: Kick ash into Darvak's eyes and crawl north.
log.narration: Turn 39 | Day 1, 12:57 amDexterity checkd20: 6 -- failedYou kick a sheet of ash into Darvak Vareth’s face, but your ruined leg has no strength left for escape. The dwarf recoils, then his spear haft crashes across your shoulders and pins you to the road.🔊………

log.action: Use the black stone marker as cover from Darvak's spear.
log.narration: Turn 40 | Day 1, 12:58 amStrength checkd20: 13 -- failedYou wrench against the spear and drag yourself toward the black stone marker. The shaft of Darvak Vareth’s weapon scrapes your mail, but the marker takes the thrust and splits the line between you. You reach its lee side, pinned leg trailing uselessly in the ash.🔊………

log.action: Drive the broken spoke into Darvak’s spear arm.
log.narration: Turn 41 | Day 1, 12:59 amBroken spoke attackd20: 17 -- successImprovised weapon damaged20: 4 -- damageYou seize the broken spoke and thrust beneath the black marker’s edge. The wood punches through Darvak Vareth’s mail at the elbow, and his spear dips as blood darkens his glove. He snarls and wrenches backward, but he does not release the weapon.🔊………

log.action: Drive the broken spoke into Darvak’s spear arm.
log.narration: Turn 42 | Day 1, 1:00 amImprovised weapon attackd20: 11 -- failedYou wrench the spoke free and drive it into Darvak Vareth’s wounded arm again. The dwarf twists aside, and the splinter skids through mail without finding flesh. His spear rises toward your exposed throat.🔊………

log.action: Twist the broken spoke deeper into Darvak’s spear arm.
log.narration: Turn 43 | Day 1, 1:01 amStrength checkd20: 16 -- successImprovised weapon damaged20: 5 -- damageYou torque the splinter until Darvak Vareth’s arm buckles. The dwarf’s grip breaks, and his spear clatters across the stones while blood runs through the dust. He bares his teeth and reaches for a knife with his free hand.🔊………

log.action: Press the cage-marked token toward the glowing iron rungs.
log.narration: Turn 44 | Day 1, 1:02 amYou press the cage-marked token against the rung. The iron screams, and every other bar folds into the shaft wall. Behind you, Darvak Vareth’s wounded arm gives way, and he collapses before his knife clears its sheath.🔊………

log.action: Press the cage-marked token toward the glowing iron rungs.
log.narration: Turn 45 | Day 1, 1:03 amYou press the cage-marked token to the glowing rung. The iron splits with a hiss, revealing a narrow stair spiraling into violet darkness. Darvak Vareth lies wounded beside the marker, his good hand clamped over his ruined arm, and his eyes fix upon the opening with sudden terror.🔊………

log.action: Disarm Darvak Vareth before he draws the knife.
log.narration: Turn 46 | Day 1, 1:04 amStrength checkd20: 17 -- successYour boot pins Darvak Vareth’s wrist before the knife clears its sheath. You wrench the blade free and fling it into the thorn scrub. The dwarf snarls through clenched teeth, but his ruined arm cannot answer your strength.🔊………

log.action: Bind Darvak Vareth’s ruined arm with cloth.
log.narration: Turn 47 | Day 1, 1:14 amFirst Aid checkd20: 13 -- failedYou tear a strip from your cloak and cinch Darvak Vareth’s ruined arm against his chest. The cloth darkens, but the bleeding slows beneath your brutal knot.🔊………

log.action: Bind Darvak Vareth’s ruined arm with cloth.
log.narration: Turn 48 | Day 1, 1:24 amFirst Aid checkd20: 12 -- failedDarvak Vareth jerks against your grip, but you wrench the cloth tight around his arm. The knot holds, though blood still seeps through the fibers.🔊………

log.action: Descend the narrow stair into violet darkness.
log.narration: Turn 49 | Day 1, 1:34 amThe stair drinks the road behind you. Violet fire crawls beneath each iron rung, and the air tastes of hot metal and old blood. Below, something shifts behind the black glass, then strikes it once from within.🔊………

log.action: Descend the narrow stair into violet darkness.
